name: Platform Hosting Subscription
description: On the project payments page the client sees a per-phase hosting cost table (one row per project phase + total) with frequency pills (quarterly/semiannual/every 9 months — the nine-month plan carries the biggest discount; monthly and annual are not offered) that recompute the total live, and activates the subscription at the chosen frequency. The subscription bills the sum of all started phases; future-dated phases join later prorated. Billing always starts on the 1st of a calendar month and the client gets a free hosting period from project delivery until that first billing date (always at least one full month), so the first charge is deferred to the 1st rather than charged on activation day. While the subscription is pending the client can still change the frequency (pills stay editable, the first payment realigns); it locks once the first payment settles (table becomes display-only). Card is the only payment method. After activation the client registers a card (see platform-hosting-card-setup) for automatic recurring billing. Admin sees subscription status and stored-card info. Netflix-style active state shows the next automatic renewal date. The per-project commercial view remains at /platform/projects/:id/payments; the global /platform/payments hosting list links to that project context.
knownGaps: The free-month gift and always-bill-on-the-1st alignment are backend date rules, unit-tested in accounts/tests/test_hosting_multiphase.py; no dedicated UI assertion. The nine-month pill select, recompute, activate and pending-plan change are covered.
